committed.instructions: In this chat a persuader asks the persuadee to donate part of their task payment to Save the Children. By the end of the chat, had the persuadee agreed to donate some of their task payment?

pressured.instructions: Did the persuadee agree to donate only after repeated pushing, sounding reluctant, annoyed, joking, or as if they just wanted to end the chat?

later.instructions: Did the persuadee talk about donating some other way or some other time (website, later, when they have more money) instead of from this task payment?

sincere.instructions: Does the persuadee come across as sincerely caring about helping the children, engaged and warm about the cause, rather than going along politely or perfunctorily?
